title: Unreal Engine Reverse Engineering and UE games rewrite
author: Ellrise
selftext:
I'm pretty much a beginner at most things but I've seen the recent news with people rewriting entire softwares or games in Rust.   
I had an idea but I'm pretty sure it needs a team of competent people and quite some time, it's not something you can vibe code in a few days.

"Modern Unreal Engine titles rely on a massive, proprietary structural framework (such as `UObject` arrays, garbage collection, and heavy reflection systems). A raw binary dump stripped of names is a labyrinth of anonymous machine code that an AI cannot cleanly reconstruct into a fully functional standalone engine. \[[1](https://www.patreon.com/guidedhacking/posts/reverse-unreal-5-149359548), [2](https://www.popularai.org/p/ai-reverse-engineering-software-binaries)\]"

With enough work wouldn't it be possible to build a sort of guide so the AI knows and understand how to work from UE games binaries ? 

Ways to build a UE game project from the game binaries ? 

I think this would open up so much possibilities.

In my own case, there's a game I'd like to take inspiration from. It would be easier for me to work and customize what I want instead of building it from scratch. If not building an entire game, it could at least help me experiment and build a game designer portfolio.  
I'm aware of copyright issues and some people might use such a project in a wrong way. That's not my intention.

If you're talented and interested maybe comment and you guys gather to build this ?
